title: Flávio Bolsonaro Leaves Brazil for the U.S. After Election Defeat
summary_full: Officials in Argentina said Mr. Bolsonaro entered the country by land then flew to Ecuador. Brazilian police had asked him to hand over his passports because of his links to an investigation.
